title: UPDATE: Girl I've gone on a few dates with mentioned persistent dream world she visits
content: Finally got the interview finished a few days ago, but I've been pretty busy. I will upload the first of two or possibly three parts of the transcript here, the rest coming over the course of the next few days. Hope you all enjoy, and please feel free to ask any questions or make any observations that you think of. Enjoy! \~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~ Z: How active are your dreams? Do you dream frequently and remember them often? T: I actually am very active in my dreams, I pretty much dream every night. There are some periods, maybe like 2 months or so, where I don’t have any dreams, but I don’t realize it until I start dreaming again. Z: Do you keep a dream journal? T: Not regularly. In college I had to keep a dream journal, and I still have that somewhere, but no I usually don’t write them down. Z: Do you ever have lucid dreams? T: I almost always know when I’m dreaming, and like I can wake up from a dream and go back to sleep and get right back into it if I want to. Z: Ok cool. That’s really what I wanted to ask you about. Persistent dream worlds. Is that something that you would consider yourself to experience? T: So, when I was in high school and was into like Wicca and tarot and new age stuff like that, I would always go in my dreams to this one mall. And the stores were always the same, it wasn’t \[name of local mall redacted\]. Z: Not a mall that you’ve ever been to in real life then? Not someplace in the real world? T: Right, no. Sometimes there would be this empty storefront, and there would be a tarot or fortune reader who had this little booth set up out in front of the empty store. Sometimes I would go see her, and we would just sort of talk in passing, but most times I didn’t go and see her. Z: Would you recognize people there in the mall? See people you know from real life, or people that you just recognize in the dream? T: \*thinking\* Hmm, no. Z: Would you be or go outside of the mall ever? T: Huh-uh, no. Z: How big was it? T: It was huge. It would be like \[other somewhat local mall in major city redacted\], only much bigger even. Z: What was the architecture like, the style of the mall? T: It seemed like it was one level for most part, and then there was a section that would go into two or maybe more levels. Where it went into two levels it was more, like… curved? Kind of like Wizard of Oz, like… Z: How do you mean? T: Like, umm, Emerald City. Like when you’re inside the palace. Z: Like, domed almost? With - I don’t know how to say - support beams that are almost like arches? T: Uh huh, yeah like that. Z: Were there skylights? Windows? T: \*thinking\* I don’t remember. Z: Were there any pools, fountains, that sort of thing? T: \*shakes head\* Z: So not a ‘90s mall then. T: \*laughs\* nope. Z: Can you tell me about the stores you remember? T: There was like, a big dress store… I don’t know, never really paid close attention. It was usually like, meeting people and like, walking and talking with them. Z: But not people that you knew? T: Huh-uh. Z: And you were otherwise there alone, like you had gone alone? T: Mmm hmm. Z: Were you lucid in these dreams, semi-lucid, or not lucid? T: \*thinking\* No I don’t think so. Z: How frequently would you have these dreams? T: Of going to that mall in high school? Pretty often. It was like, a regular go-to… So like, more than five times definitely. Z: did you ever go to the food court? T: Huh-uh. And I don’t ever remember seeing one. Z: Toy store? T: I want to say there was a toy store, yeah. Z: Was there a movie theater? T: No, not that I ever saw at least. &#x200B; &#x200B; \~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~\~ More to come. Thanks for reading.
